nodes.text: Let $(A_i)$ be a family of sets with $\lvert A_i\rvert=\aleph_0$ for all $i$, such that for any $i\neq j$ we have $\lvert A_i\cap A_j\rvert$ finite and $\neq 1$. Is there a $2$-colouring of $\cup A_i$ such that no $A_i$ is monochromatic?

#602 : [Er87] combinatorics | set theory A problem of Komjáth. The existence of such a $2$-colouring is sometimes known as Property B.
